saw_lines: Garden buyers plan for years. They compare footprint, delivery and build quality, then choose one and expect it to last.
So the sale is won in the first line, where the offer decides whether a buyer clicks or scrolls past.
Your site offers 5% off through subscribe and save, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it. Open three new ads with the offer in the first line and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 5% off through subscribe and save, yet 0 of 18 ads mention it. A buyer who sees no discount has no reason to click. Open three new ads with the offer and print it on the creative.

Your site promotes subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention a subscription. Without it, returning buyers have no reason to reorder. Run two retention ads with the subscription saving as the headline, aimed at past buyers.

None of your 28 ads shows a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing concrete to trust before they click. Pick one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.
Creator posts run as brand ads
7 of 18 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the creator’s own account does not carry the ad. Whitelist those posts from the creator accounts and cut three variations of the best one.
